description:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Matt Miller and Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Apple caps a blockbuster earnings week with a strong outlook, while Jane Street’s pay pool surges past Wall Street giants. Tensions rise as Iran floats a new proposal and President Trump doubles down on a naval blockade. OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar flags explosive demand. Billionaire Jorge Perez explains Miami’s boom. Brunswick’s CEO give us details on resilient boat demand. And Como 1907’s Mirwan Suwarso joins Bloomberg Open Interest on how he's building a luxury sports empire.
